explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

i have a website running under localhost. i am trying to use the following code to undestand my website, not working.
<html><body>
<a href="/index.php">XXXXX</a>
</body></html>

it doesn't work.
you can see the code here: https://github.com/petermoehle/undrust
any suggestions?

a:

you need to create a htm file. here's an example:
<html><body><a href="{{ url }}">XXXXX</a></body></html>

notice how the "{{ url }}" in your <a href=""></a> tag is replaced by the link's actual value.
you can then use your htm file like so:
<html><body>
<a href="{{url}}">XXXXX</a>
</body></html>

you can check out the link above to see how this works with the code in your question.
also, when your site is running under a specific ip address, the browser will not load your content, it will only load the index.html file.
